start.title: Court Booker books for you at {{start}} every morning, even while you sleep

steps.1: Do the setup tasks below, once.
steps.2: On the Booking page, choose the account, sport, court and slots of each machine.
steps.3: Press "{{dryRun}}"; once it passes, turn on "{{daily}}".

prepare.title: Getting ready
prepare.note: Yours to do, once. Tick when done.

mumu.title: MuMu Player is installed
mumu.hint: Download it from mumuplayer.com and install it like any program.

app.title: Vinhomes Resident is installed in MuMu
app.hint: Open the Play Store in MuMu and look for Vinhomes Resident.

login.title: The Vinhomes app is logged in
login.hint: A resident account. Choose one on the Booking page so the app logs in by itself.

morning.title: Every morning
morning.wake: The PC wakes and opens MuMu and the Vinhomes app. An account logged in that is not the chosen one is changed.
morning.start: The slots chosen are booked, usually within 15 seconds.
morning.after: The tickets' pictures are in Management, under Tickets.
morning.needsText: sleep rather than shut down, stay signed in to Windows, and be plugged in if it is a laptop.

notRunning.question: Nothing ran this morning
notRunning.answer: The PC was shut down instead of asleep, or signed out of Windows.

slotFull.question: It says "{{slotFull}}"
slotFull.answer: Someone booked that slot first. Choose another on the Booking page.

quota.question: The flat used up its bookings
quota.answer: 8 slots a month at most. Cancel the ones you do not need in the Vinhomes app.

loggedOut.question: The app was logged out
loggedOut.answer: Choose the machine's account on the Booking page so a run logs in by itself. If the app says the password is wrong, change it on the Management page: the app locks an account after 5 wrong ones.
